gloss: cabinet decision; decision by the cabinet

definitions.gloss: cabinet decision; decision by the cabinet
definitions.explanation: A formal decision made collectively by the members of the cabinet (the prime minister and ministers of state).

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{閣議決定|かくぎけってい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bill was approved by the cabinet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閣議決定|かくぎけってい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The government approved new economic measures by cabinet decision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閣議決定|かくぎけってい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}される→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The budget proposal goes through cabinet approval before being submitted to the Diet.

notes:
A key term in Japanese politics and news. ⟦{閣議|かくぎ}→閣議：22416_kakugi⟧ means 'cabinet meeting' and ⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧ means 'decision.' In Japan's parliamentary system, bills must receive {閣議決定|かくぎけってい} before being submitted to the ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧ (Diet/parliament). The term appears constantly in news reports about government policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閣議決定|かくぎけってい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to decide by cabinet resolution
- {閣議決定|かくぎけってい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out a cabinet decision
- {閣議決定|かくぎけってい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧: after cabinet approval
- {閣議決定|かくぎけってい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: based on a cabinet decision

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{閣議|かくぎ}→閣議：22416_kakugi⟧: cabinet meeting
- ⟦{閣僚|かくりょう}→閣僚：20561_kakuryou⟧: cabinet minister
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧: the Diet (Japan's parliament)
- ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧: bill; legislative proposal
- ⟦{政令|せいれい}→政令：24773_seirei⟧: government ordinance — issued based on cabinet decisions without Diet approval
